A city built by its followers.

The idea

You are the population.

Every episode, a city grows, and the audience builds it. Follow and you become a citizen. Comment and you get a house with your name on it. The most-liked comment decides what gets built next. The green population sign at the edge of town is the show's signature. It counts the real followers, so the hook and the brand are the same thing.

Name

Population: You

Six candidates, ranked. Before you commit, check that the handles and domain are free on each platform and run a trademark search. These suggestions haven't been checked for availability.

Population: You RecommendedRecommended. Turns the signature sign into the name and makes the viewer the subject. The sign can show the real follower count every episode, so the hook is the brand.
CommentvilleThe clearest description of the mechanic. Friendly, but tied to comments only (not follows or votes).
CrowdtownShort, crowd-built and easy to say. Less specific about how the crowd builds it.
VotropolisVote + metropolis. Distinctive, but harder to spell and say out loud.
Day Zero CityLeans into the episodic 'Day N' format. Feels like a series title more than a brand.
Citizen OneStarts from 'population: 1'. Strong first episode, but the number dates as the city grows.

Logo

The sign is the logo.

It's the town sign with the number replaced by YOU. The lettering is converted to vector outlines (Inter, SIL Open Font License), so the SVGs look the same on any device.

Primary · logo.svg. Use it wherever there's room for the posts.
Board · logo-board.svg. For tight spaces, watermarks and end cards.
Avatar · avatar.svg / png/avatar.png. Safe inside a circle crop.
Wordmark · wordmark.svg. For text-only spots.
Wordmark on dark · wordmark-white.svg
  • Clear space: keep the height of the word YOU empty around the sign.
  • Minimum size: 120 px wide for the board, 48 px for the avatar.
  • Don't recolour the board, stretch it, add effects, or put a number in place of YOU in the logo. Numbers belong on the in-show sign.

Colour

Built from the city.

Every colour comes from the world itself: the sign, the roads, the plots and the sky. Green means the brand; orange means "you can act on this".

Type

Inter, three ways.

DAY 0
POPULATION: 1
no shops,
  • Titles: Inter Display Black, all caps, white with a hard drop shadow. One short line.
  • Label pill: Inter ExtraBold on a white pill (DAY 0, RULE 2, VOTE NOW).
  • Captions: Inter ExtraBold, white with a thick black outline. The word being spoken turns Caption Orange. Two to four words per line.
  • Sign: Inter SemiBold and Medium, letterspaced.

Inter is free under the SIL Open Font License, at rsms.me/inter.

Sound

The population going up.

The sonic logo is the counter ticking upward through a C-major arpeggio, then a pop and a bell chord when it arrives. In the voiced version the narrator says "Population: you", and the pop lands on "you". The music, sound effects and logo all come from one synth palette, generated in code, so there are no samples or licensing.

Sonic logo3 s · opens and closes every video, notification sound
Sonic logo + voice tag3.4 s · end cards, ads, the start of podcasts or streams
Theme loop8 s, loops seamlessly · 120 BPM, I–V–vi–IV in C
  • Narrator: Kokoro-82M, voice af_heart, speed 1.1. Warm, quick and slightly amused.
  • Mix: about -14 LUFS, peaks at -1 dBFS. Music drops about 10 dB under the voice.
  • Sound effects on visuals: a whoosh on every cut and a pop on every pop-in. Keep it consistent.

Voice & tone

Short. Second person. Rules, not requests.

  • Talk to one person: you. The audience are citizens, not followers.
  • State rules as rules: "Rule two: comment, and I'll build you a house."
  • Keep a line to one breath, about 4 to 9 words.
  • Every episode ends on a choice and a promise: "Vote in the comments. Results next episode."
Signature lines
  • "This city has one resident."
  • "Follow, and you're officially a citizen."
  • "Whatever it says, I build. No matter what."
  • "Results next episode."
  • "Follow to move in."

Episode formula

35–45 seconds, every time.

  1. Day + population: open on the sign with the real follower count. DAY N
  2. What changed: last vote's winner gets built on camera, with build thunks, rising floors and an impact.
  3. Shout-outs: show new houses with commenters' names on the nameplates.
  4. The top comment: show the card and the like count, and promise to build it no matter what.
  5. The vote: three plots, A / B / C, top-down. Orange tags pop in as each option is said.
  6. End card: sonic logo, "Follow to move in", handle.
